name: Kirloskar Pneumatic Company Ltd
title: Kirloskar Pneumatic Company Ltd - 505283 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 sales up 21% to INR706 crores and FY26 EBITDA margin 21.7%, but management says 18-20% is sustainable; order board up 15% to INR1,863 crores with ~INR500 crores executing beyond FY27.

capex.quote: out of the INR320 crores, roughly INR60 crores we already incurred for this and remaining, we are targeting to incur in another 2 years' time.

triggers.label: Q4 raw material ratio 50.06% vs 56.35%
triggers.quote: There is a major reduction in the percentage of raw material to sales for Q4 FY26 compared to Q4 FY25, 50.06% in Q4 FY26 against 56.35% in Q4 FY25.

triggers.label: Margin guided back to 18-20% EBITDA
triggers.quote: a margin expectation of 18% to 20% EBITDA would be more sustainable.

triggers.label: Order board up 15% to INR1,863 crores
triggers.quote: increased by 15% from INR1,624 crores recorded on April 1st , 2025.

triggers.label: Gas division growth difficulties
triggers.quote: this is a place where we have been having some difficulties in terms of growth.

triggers.label: Middle East orders slowing
triggers.quote: considering the current situation, these are going quite slowly.

guidance.quote: we are confident in achieving our growth objective of 20% plus.
a margin expectation of 18% to 20% EBITDA would be more sustainable.
our target is to take out something 20% to 25% business coming out of this Equipment business where the execution cycle is very short.
from new products, we target that we should have at least 10% to 15% of sales.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are confident in achieving our growth objective of 20% plus.
as indicated from time-to-time, our Compression business margins are sustainable in the range of 18% to 20%.

red_flags.label: Margin above guided sustainable range
red_flags.quote: this year would be a bit of an exception, a margin expectation of 18% to 20% EBITDA would be more sustainable.

red_flags.label: Opaque Precision Engineering orders
red_flags.quote: we would avoid talking too much about this business until we are clear that this is sustainable and not one-time in nature.

evasions.quote: So we generally don't give a breakup of segments.
we are not able to understand what exactly you are asking.
